## Setup


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
library(survey)
library(MEPS)      # remotes::install_github("e-mitchell/meps_r_pkg/MEPS")
library(gtsummary)

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

PANEL_YEAR <- 2021   # fix before running
```
:::


## Load public files


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fyc  <- read_MEPS(year = PANEL_YEAR, type = "FYC")   # full year consolidated
rx   <- read_MEPS(year = PANEL_YEAR, type = "RX")    # prescribed medicines
er   <- read_MEPS(year = PANEL_YEAR, type = "ER")    # emergency room visits
ip   <- read_MEPS(year = PANEL_YEAR, type = "IP")    # inpatient stays
op   <- read_MEPS(year = PANEL_YEAR, type = "OP")    # outpatient visits
cond <- read_MEPS(year = PANEL_YEAR, type = "COND")  # medical conditions
clnk <- read_MEPS(year = PANEL_YEAR, type = "CLNK")  # condition-event link
```
:::
